headline: Innovision Limited announces date for Annual General Meeting
summary: Innovision Limited has notified the NSE that its Annual General Meeting will take place on December 05, 2026. The meeting will be conducted entirely through video conferencing and other audio-visual means. Shareholders will be able to participate remotely to discuss company business.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate governance event with no immediate impact on stock price.

headline: Innovision Limited responds to stock price movement query by the exchange
hook: Exchange seeks clarity on sharp price movement

Innovision Limited has submitted its official response to the exchange regarding the movement. Such standard exchange queries aim to ensure that the market has access to all relevant and latest information about the listed entity. Indian retail investors tracking the stock should review the company's official disclosure on the exchange portal for any material developments before taking action.

headline: Innovision Limited wins Rs 94.97 crore toll contract in Chhattisgarh
hook: New NHAI contract for Innovision Limited
summary: Innovision Limited has been awarded a toll collection and maintenance contract by the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI). The project is valued at Rs 94.97 crore and is located in the state of Chhattisgarh. This contract adds to the company's order book for infrastructure services.
why_it_matters: Revenue visibility improves for the company's infrastructure division.
